before.limits: Four-state linear reduction; height/engine coupling omitted. Python outputs physical states (C=I); MATLAB first rows output airspeed/angle of attack. No nonlinear or flight-test validation.

after.limits: Four-state linear reduction; height/engine coupling omitted. Python outputs physical states (C=I); MATLAB first rows output airspeed/angle of attack. No nonlinear or flight-test validation.

limitations: Correct A3C gradient does not improve this benchmark at unchanged hyperparameters; all three seeds regress.
Single inline worker; no proof of asynchronous multi-worker convergence or GPU behavior.
Fixed scenarios at 2 and 10 seconds; no global stability claim.
Four-state UAV is a linear reduction, with height/engine feedback omitted.
The printed six-state source matrix has an unstable phugoid pair, inconsistent with the poles printed next to it; used as a sensitivity test, not flight truth.
Changing native action_space bounds affects policies which scale actions using those bounds; this benchmark uses an explicit 3-degree adapter.
Ray tests excluded because Ray is not installed. Temporary artifacts may be removed.
